::: {.proto-facts}
Status
: [In production]{.proto-status .s-prod}

What it is
: The BigPicture data repository, where slides and their metadata are stored. It receives submissions, keeps the data secure, and gives approved users their downloads. It is built on the Sensitive Data Archive (SDA).

Who it's for
: Data contributors, who submit and store data, and data users, who download what they are approved for.

Provided by
: NBIS

Before you start
: - An [LS AAI](lsaai.qmd) login with [Perun](perun.qmd) membership.
  - To contribute: be a consortium member or have a contributing-partner (SCTP) agreement.
  - To download: an approved application in [REMS](rems.qmd).

How to get access
: Get your upload or download credentials at [login.bp.nbis.se](https://login.bp.nbis.se/). Then follow the [Submission manual](../datasets/submission/index.qmd) or the [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd).

Guides
: - [Submission manual (clinical)](../datasets/submission/index.qmd)
  - [Download guide](../datasets/download/downloading-data.qmd)

Terms and privacy
: Data Submission Guideline and Data Sharing Agreement [(SharePoint, members)]{.text-muted} · [BigPicture privacy notice](https://bigpicture.eu/bigpicture-privacy-notice)

Support
: ::: {.proto-help}
  [servicedesk@bigpicture.eu](mailto:servicedesk@bigpicture.eu){.proto-mail}
